FMaS2nZn.name: Debugify 26.3.0.0
FMaS2nZn.changelog:
# Debugify 26.3.0.0

## Changes

Update to 26.3

## Removed fixes

These bugs have been fixed by Mojang and no longer need patching:

- [MC-44654](https://mojira.dev/MC-44654) - Some entities don't update position to the client when teleported
- [MC-59810](https://mojira.dev/MC-59810) - Cannot break blocks while sprinting on macOS
- [MC-81773](https://mojira.dev/MC-81773) - Bows, crossbows, and tridents drawn in survival/creative/adventure mode can be released in spectator mode
- [MC-122477](https://mojira.dev/MC-122477) - Opening chat sometimes writes the character of the key used to open it
- [MC-129909](https://mojira.dev/MC-129909) - Players in spectator mode continue to consume foods and liquids shortly after switching game modes
- [MC-159283](https://mojira.dev/MC-159283) - Terrain generation fails in progressively shrinking rings centred on the world origin
- [MC-206540](https://mojira.dev/MC-206540) - Increased input delay when riding an entity
- [MC-206705](https://mojira.dev/MC-206705) - Spyglasses stay in use in spectator mode
- [MC-227008](https://mojira.dev/MC-227008) - Endermen constantly try to teleport when riding a vehicle under daylight
- [MC-259512](https://mojira.dev/MC-259512) - Horizontal camera rotation lags when riding
- [MC-298066](https://mojira.dev/MC-298066) - Directly entering a bed from a mount places the player in the wrong place

X1g3VhTx.name: 1.11.3-26.3 - Fabric
X1g3VhTx.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fix frustumculling not using whitelist, Fix frustum-culling using the uninflated hitbox. Fix [#341](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/341). This should fix any weird pop-in/outs happening when just turning the camera
- Make the entity reference weak to prevent leaks caused by Fabric API. Fix [#6](https://github.com/tr7zw/TRansition/issues/6) . Over multiple corners, TRansition(one of my libs) with FabricAPI caused a leak of the entire level when leaving a world, wasting memory. 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/compare/1.11.2...1.11.3

te2y9qZn.name: [Fabric] Sodium Extra 0.9.4 - Minecraft 26.3
te2y9qZn.changelog:
### Changed

- Ported Sodium Extra to Minecraft 26.3.
- Reworked Reduce Resolution on macOS to use SDL's high pixel-density window handling.
- Improved planar and custom fog distance handling.

### Removed

- Removed the Wayland/XWayland Fullscreen Resolution option and recovery flow; Sodium now provides this support.
- Removed the legacy macOS OpenGL and Vulkan framebuffer/presentation workarounds; SDL now handles the required window scaling.

### Fixed

- Fixed Panini Projection scaling with the active FOV.
- Fixed blank tooltip translations.
- Fixed custom fog distance encoding and preservation.
- Improved fog rendering compatibility by avoiding a Redirect.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FlashyReese/sodium-extra/compare/mc26.2-0.9.4...mc26.3-0.9.4
